summary: In the staircase, Morpheus looks up the stairs as he hears a HELICOPTER and urges the others on with "Come on!" As the threat approaches, Apoc slaps a gun into Neo's hand, calling it "Something to ward off evil spirits." Neo nods and stuffs the weapon into his belt, arming himself.

what_changes.before: Unarmed, reacting to the sound of the helicopter
what_changes.evidence: Apoc slaps a gun into Neo's hand. APOC Something to ward off evil spirits. Neo nods, stuffing it into his belt.

event_hint.one_line: The crew braces for the arriving helicopter assault as they arm themselves.
